# Family Kitchen Da Nang

> Authentic Vietnamese cooking class hosted in a real family home in Da Nang, Vietnam, run by Jérôme & Julia, a Franco-Vietnamese couple of former professional chefs. Classes include a local market tour and hands-on cooking of 6 traditional Vietnamese dishes.

## Key facts

- Location: Da Nang, Vietnam (42 Lê Hữu Trác, An Hải, Đà Nẵng 55000). Exact address given on booking confirmation.
- Price: from $35 USD per person.
- Group size: 1 to 8 people (private groups welcome).
- Schedule: every day, Monday to Sunday, two sessions (9:30 AM and 2:00 PM).
- Duration: approx. 3 hours, including a local market visit.
- What's included: market tour, cooking 6 traditional Vietnamese dishes (Vietnamese egg coffee, fresh spring rolls, Vietnamese salad, bánh xèo, seasonal soup, surprise dessert), a recipe booklet, vegetarian/vegan options on request.
- Languages spoken: English, French, German, and Korean.
- Rating: 5/5 average on Google Reviews.
- Contact: familykitchendanang@gmail.com · WhatsApp +84 947 895 066.
- Booking: via the contact form on the website, email, or WhatsApp.
